description: This Java source file defines the NotesApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing notes associated with various resources (clients, loans, groups, etc.) in the Fineract platform. It includes methods for retrieving, adding, updating, and deleting notes, with permission checks and resource type handling.

classes.name: NotesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing notes related to various resources such as clients, loans, and groups.

methods.name: retrieveNotesByResource
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve notes for a specific resource type and ID.

methods.name: retrieveNote
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific note by its ID for a resource.

methods.name: addNewNote
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new note to a resource.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note.

methods.name: getResourceDetails
methods.description: Helper method to build command wrapper with resource identifiers based on note type.
